about_the_game:
Heir to the Throne (HttT) is an action role-playing game with borrowings from the hack’n’slay and rogue-lite genres in a top-down perspective. It is being developed for cooperative multiplayer mode, but will also be playable in single player – albeit with an increased difficulty level. Other features include direct controls, no fixed classes, randomized loot, randomized skills, randomized dungeons and more.

Roguelite Single- & Multiplayer

While you can play the game as a solo player, HttT also offers cooperative multiplayer mode. In the joint fight against evil, coordinate the use of your skills wisely to create synergies. Exchange found items to strengthen your party’s fighting power. While death might be inevitable, having teammates offers the rare chance to get revived.

Unique Character Development

With the approach of "you are what you wear," meaning no predefined hero classes, you have total freedom over how you want to equip and play your character. In addition, with our weapon-based random skill system we make sure that the game unfolds differently every time you play.

Various Biomes

Explore various hostile biomes with open landscapes and dungeons. These environments will be randomly generated every time you start a game. The biomes differ in terms of style, appearance and dominant culture - also regarding the enemies.

Direct Controls

We focus on direct controls, implemented for an action-oriented and dynamic gaming experience. Instead of using point-and-click to move your character, we rely on WASD for movement as well as precise aiming with the mouse. Controller support is planned as well.

Shape the game

We have created a strong basis for the game, but we need your input for new ideas and improvements: What feature would you like to see, what should we focus on or prioritize next? Wishlist the game, join our Discord and help shape the game!

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work. This content may include: Frequent Violence or Gore, Some Nudity, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel CPU 8th Gen 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 Super / AMD 6600 XT, with at least of 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced on a SSD drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel CPU 10th Gen 10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800, with at least of 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced on a M.2 SSD drive

short_description: Experience co-op action in Heir to the Throne, a rogue-lite game set in a procedurally generated world! Battle hordes of monsters, discover weapons with random skills, and combine your team's abilities strategically. Through smart teamwork you can claim the throne and fulfill your destiny!
supported_languages:
English*, German
*languages with full audio support
